ImageDescription.value:
Pink granite rocks coast, nearby Ploumanac’h (Côtes-d’Armor, Brittany, west France). This picture was taken from a place accessible only at low tide.
It is made of a mosaic of 12 pictures (2 rows of 6 snapshots) taken at 17mm on a 1.6 crop body, f/8.0, 1/250s and ISO 100. Stitching was done with Hugin and Enblend, using a cylindric projection. Resulting horizontal FOV is (taking the crop into account) slightly more than 300°.
